title: Annotatio V §.I close: POSTERIOR improper spiritual-supernatural; flesh via soul to blessed resurrection — stop before §.II
pass_a_gloss: The POSTERIOR or Improper eating in the Sacred Supper, to be called Spiritual and Supernatural, as it immensely surpasses the proper oral and carnal which is of the consecrated bread alone in the Supper, so it yields not only to the human spirit or man’s soul but also to his flesh, by the mediating soul, on account of Christ’s flesh spiritually eaten both outside and inside the Sacred Supper, unto a blessed resurrection to eternal life.
pass_b_english: §.I close: the POSTERIOR / Improper eating in the Supper is Spiritual and Supernatural — far above the proper oral/carnal of consecrated bread alone.
It benefits not soul only but flesh too (soul mediating), because of Christ’s flesh spiritually eaten in and outside the Supper, unto blessed resurrection. Stop before §.II.
source_text: POSTERIOR, seu Impropria, in S. Cœna, Spiritualis & Supernaturalis appellanda, uti propriâ orali & carnali, quæ solius panis consecrati in Cœna est, immane quantum præstat; ita non spiritui duntaxat humano, seu hominis animæ, verùm etiam carni ejus, mediante anima, propter carnem Christi, spiritualiter, cùm extra, tùm intra Cœnam S., comestam, in beatam, ad vitam æternam, resurrectionem cedit.
notes: §.I close: posterior spiritual; flesh via soul; before §.II.
